findings.issue: `?limit=0` or `?minReviews=0` is silently replaced by the default (10 / 1) instead of being validated or rejected, because `|| default` treats 0 as falsy.
findings.evidence:
const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) || 10, 1), 50);
const minReviews = Math.max(parseInt(req.query.minReviews as string, 10) || 1, 1);

findings.issue: `?page=0` is coerced to 1 via `|| 1` before the `page < 1` check runs, so the validation can never catch an explicit page=0 and silently serves page 1 instead of 400.
